Approximately 42 apartments will be set aside for supportive housing run by the Brooklyn Community Housing Services. What that means is that not only will there be set-aside for people who need additional support, but there will be on-site supportive office where case managers from the Brooklyn Community Housing Services will be there to offer on-site supportive services. We are using a canopy solar system on the roof that will generate somewhere between 300 to 400 kilowatt hours of energy to offset any energy usage to heat and cool the building. In addition to that, to address the City's concern around a climate change affecting the City's landscape, we are incorporating on-site detention tanks to minimize the amount of rain that can go onto streets and create flooding.
